title: Zarathustra and the Gathas
summary: Position 1: linguistic dating places the Gathas and their composer around 1500-1000 BCE. Position 2: a later tradition dates Zarathustra to the 6th century BCE. The hymns' vision of Ahura Mazda and the choice between truth and the lie found the religion either way.
